findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "View Details" above "1,340"; "Department" above "410+"; "Students" above "300+"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.hub-hero → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(119, 29, 29) 0%, rgb(167, 38, 38) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.hub-hero → rgba(21, 2, 2, 0.18) 0px 14px 34px 0px | a.hub-card.is-instagram → rgba(21, 2, 2, 0.05) 0px 6px 18px 0px | a.hub-card.is-facebook → rgba(21, 2, 2, 0.05) 0px 6px 18px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 3189px of nothing between: "Achievements"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (40px, 968px, 267px, 537px, 877px, 643px, 1120px); the three most used hold only 60% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "1,340" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "15.40" (screen 3, 75% hidden); "11.74" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "9.24" (screen 3, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Little motion: 13 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 403px of the width empty: "Vision".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The h1 is 24px ("NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY ROURKELA").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.
